CaseSummaryUsage.description:
The token usage of the calls that wrote a case summary.

One call, or two when the first response was rejected on a mechanical rule
of the body contract and retried; the figures sum both.

estimated_cost_usd.description: The calls' on-demand cost at `pricing.MODEL_RATES` for `model` — an estimate at the rate table's snapshot, like every figure it prices
estimated_cost_usd.title: Estimated Cost Usd

CaseSummaryUsage.title: CaseSummaryUsage

description:
The YAML front matter of ``data/ai-cases/summaries/<entry_id>.md``.

A plain-language summary of one AI watchlist ruling, for the AI-cases
update (``docs/case-summaries.md``, *AI watchlist rulings*). Written by the
harness, never by the model: the court-record identifiers the summary is
filed under, the digest of the ruling text it was written from, and the
model and prompt that wrote it.

body_version.description: The body contract the summary was written to (`ai_rulings.SECTION_HEADINGS`): 1, a one-sentence `In brief` headline and `What the court decided`
body_version.title: Body Version

case.description: The watchlist case's name, as the watchlist gives it
case.title: Case

court.description: CourtListener court id of the docket
court.title: Court

date_filed.description: The day the ruling was filed
date_filed.title: Date Filed

entry_id.description: CourtListener's id for the docket entry; the file is named for it
entry_id.title: Entry Id

entry_number.description: The entry's number on the docket; unnumbered entries carry none
entry_number.title: Entry Number

generated_at.description: When the harness wrote the file (UTC)
generated_at.title: Generated At

kind.description: What the entry is, under the activity rule that recorded it
kind.title: Kind

model.description: The Messages API model id that wrote the body
model.title: Model

text_digest.description: sha256 of the ruling's text as stored, before the contact scrub — the text the summary was written from
text_digest.title: Text Digest

usage.description: The token usage of the calls that wrote the summary (a rejected first response's included), where the responses carried it

title: AiRulingSummaryFrontMatter
